scope: Clear inherited parent recursion guard for oya verify CI-mirror integration-test fixture
claim: The oya_verify_ci_mirror integration-test fixture now launches its intentionally fresh top-level verifier without inheriting the parent OYA_VERIFY_RUNNING recursion guard; the real verifier still refuses actual recursive oya verify invocations in child commands.

source_inspection.root_cause: crates/oya-dev-cli/tests/oya_verify_ci_mirror.rs launches CARGO_BIN_EXE_oya to test top-level verify behavior against fake cargo/oya/git shims. When the test file is run underneath ./bin/oya verify --ci-required, it inherits OYA_VERIFY_RUNNING=1 from the parent verifier and fails at the top-level recursion guard before the fixture can assert CI-mirror behavior.
source_inspection.guard_implementation: crates/oya-dev-cli/src/commands/verify.rs refuses top-level verify when OYA_VERIFY_RUNNING=1 and deliberately exports that variable to child commands to prevent real nested verifier recursion.
source_inspection.test_fixture: crates/oya-dev-cli/tests/oya_verify_ci_mirror.rs VerifyFixture::run now removes OYA_VERIFY_RUNNING only for fixture-spawned top-level verifier commands. The fake child command environment remains the unit under test for CI-mirror step ordering and exit semantics.
